description_en: Modifies the permissions of an image sharing group

kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-image-share-group-permission --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyImageShareGroupPermission

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call DescribeRegions to query available regions
parameters.help_zh: 地域 ID。您可以调用 DescribeRegions 查询可用地域

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which you want to grant image sharing permissions

parameters.name: add_group_1

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group from which you want to remove image sharing permissions

parameters.name: remove_group_1

schema.description_zh: 修改镜像共享组权限的返回结果
